title: Amazon Data Firehose
focus: managed delivery to S3/Redshift/OpenSearch/Splunk/HTTP, buffering size/interval, Lambda transformation, record format conversion to Parquet/ORC via Glue schema, dynamic partitioning, no replay, vs Kinesis Data Streams

title: Amazon MSK
focus: managed Apache Kafka: brokers, topics, partitions, replication factor, MSK Serverless vs provisioned, MSK Connect, IAM auth, Kafka API compatibility, retention, vs Kinesis

title: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
focus: stateful stream processing, windows (tumbling/sliding/session), checkpoints/snapshots, exactly-once, KPUs, sources KDS/MSK, sinks, Studio notebooks

title: AWS DataSync
focus: online transfer from on-prem NFS/SMB/HDFS/object storage to S3/EFS/FSx, agent, scheduling, bandwidth limits, verification, incremental, vs Snow Family vs Transfer Family

title: AWS Transfer Family
focus: managed SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2 endpoints into S3/EFS, partners keep their clients, managed workflows, identity providers, vs DataSync

title: Amazon AppFlow
focus: no-code SaaS ingestion (Salesforce, SAP, Zendesk, Slack, ServiceNow) to S3/Redshift, on-demand/scheduled/event flows, filters, mapping, PrivateLink

title: AWS Snow Family
focus: offline petabyte transfer (Snowball Edge), edge compute, when network is too slow (rule of thumb: >1 week online), import into S3, encryption

title: AWS Data Exchange
focus: subscribe to third-party data products, delivery to S3, Redshift data shares, API and Lake Formation data sets, entitlements, auto-export

title: AWS Glue ETL
focus: serverless Spark/Python shell jobs, DynamicFrames vs DataFrames, DPUs/worker types, job bookmarks, connections, Glue Studio, Flex execution, pushdown predicates, small-file grouping

title: AWS Glue Data Catalog & Crawlers
focus: Hive-compatible metastore for Athena/EMR/Redshift Spectrum, crawlers and classifiers, partitions and partition projection, schema changes, MSCK REPAIR vs crawler, catalog permissions

title: AWS Glue DataBrew & Data Quality
focus: DataBrew visual recipes (250+ transforms), profiling, PII handling; Glue Data Quality with DQDL rules, rulesets, recommendations, actions on failure

title: Amazon EMR
focus: Spark/Hive/Presto/HBase on EC2 clusters, primary/core/task nodes, spot for task nodes, EMR Serverless, EMR on EKS, EMRFS on S3, transient vs long-running, managed scaling

title: AWS Lambda
focus: event-driven transforms, 15-min timeout, memory up to 10 GB, /tmp up to 10 GB, concurrency (reserved/provisioned), event source mappings (KDS/SQS/DynamoDB Streams), batch size, destinations, layers

title: AWS Step Functions
focus: state machines (Task, Choice, Parallel, Map, Wait), Standard vs Express workflows, service integrations (Glue, EMR, Athena, Lambda), retries/catch, .sync pattern, Distributed Map

title: Amazon MWAA
focus: managed Apache Airflow, DAGs in S3, environment classes, workers autoscaling, plugins/requirements.txt, operators for AWS services, when to pick vs Step Functions

title: Amazon EventBridge
focus: event bus, rules and patterns, schedules (EventBridge Scheduler, cron/rate), S3 event notifications to EventBridge, targets (Glue, Step Functions, Lambda), archive/replay, cross-account

title: Amazon SNS & Amazon SQS
focus: SNS pub/sub fan-out, SQS queues (standard vs FIFO), visibility timeout, dead-letter queues, long polling, SNS->SQS fan-out, decoupling and resilient pipelines, alerting

title: Amazon Bedrock
focus: foundation models via API inside pipelines (classification, extraction, summarisation), batch inference, Knowledge Bases (RAG, vector stores), guardrails, invoking from Lambda/Glue/Step Functions

title: Amazon Redshift
focus: leader/compute nodes and slices, RA3 managed storage and Serverless (RPUs), distribution styles (AUTO/EVEN/KEY/ALL) and sort keys with zone maps, COPY/UNLOAD, zero-ETL and streaming ingestion, Spectrum, concurrency scaling, WLM/SQA, data sharing

title: Amazon S3
focus: data lake storage, prefixes and partitioning, storage classes, lifecycle policies, versioning, Object Lock, replication (CRR/SRR), event notifications, performance (3,500 PUT / 5,500 GET per prefix per s), encryption

title: Amazon S3 Tables & Apache Iceberg
focus: open table format: ACID, schema evolution, time travel, hidden partitioning; S3 Tables table buckets with automatic compaction and snapshot management; query via Athena/EMR/Glue/Redshift

title: Amazon DynamoDB
focus: key-value/document NoSQL, partition and sort keys, GSI vs LSI, on-demand vs provisioned capacity (RCU/WCU), TTL, DynamoDB Streams, export to S3, zero-ETL to Redshift/OpenSearch, hot partitions

title: Amazon RDS & Aurora
focus: managed relational OLTP sources, read replicas, Multi-AZ, Aurora storage, Aurora Serverless v2, zero-ETL to Redshift, Federated Query, pgvector, snapshots/exports to S3

title: Amazon Athena
focus: serverless SQL over S3 via Glue Catalog, pay per TB scanned, partitioning/partition projection, columnar formats and compression, CTAS/INSERT INTO, workgroups and limits, federated query, Spark notebooks

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service
focus: search and log analytics, indexes/shards, domains vs Serverless collections, ingestion via Firehose/OpenSearch Ingestion, UltraWarm/cold storage, dashboards, vector search (k-NN)

title: Amazon QuickSight
focus: BI dashboards, SPICE in-memory engine vs direct query, data sources (Athena, Redshift, S3), row-level security, ML insights/Q natural language, embedding

title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio & Catalog
focus: unified studio for data and AI, domains/projects, SageMaker Catalog (business data catalog, glossary, lineage, data publishing and subscription), integration with Lake Formation and Redshift

title: AWS IAM
focus: roles for services (Glue, EMR, Lambda execution roles), identity vs resource-based policies, least privilege, policy evaluation (explicit deny wins), cross-account roles, permission boundaries, IAM Identity Center

title: AWS Lake Formation
focus: fine-grained permissions on Glue Catalog (database/table/column/row/cell), LF-Tags (tag-based access control), data filters, cross-account sharing via RAM, registering S3 locations, vs IAM-only

title: AWS KMS
focus: encryption at rest, AWS managed vs customer managed keys, key policies, envelope encryption, SSE-KMS vs SSE-S3, cross-account key use, key rotation, encryption in transit with TLS

title: AWS Secrets Manager & Parameter Store
focus: storing DB credentials/API keys, automatic rotation (Secrets Manager), Parameter Store standard vs advanced tiers, SecureString with KMS, cost differences, Glue connections and Lambda retrieving secrets

title: Amazon Macie
focus: discovering PII/sensitive data in S3 with managed and custom data identifiers, automated discovery, findings to EventBridge/Security Hub, follow-up masking with Glue/Redshift

title: AWS CloudTrail
focus: API audit logs, management vs data events, trails to S3, CloudTrail Lake (SQL over events), organization trails, log file integrity validation, integration with CloudWatch Logs

title: Amazon CloudWatch
focus: metrics, alarms, dashboards, CloudWatch Logs and Logs Insights queries, metric filters, monitoring Glue/EMR/Lambda/Kinesis pipelines, SNS notifications, anomaly detection

title: AWS Config
focus: resource configuration history, managed and custom rules (compliance), conformance packs, remediation via SSM, aggregators, data residency/sovereignty evidence

title: AWS CloudFormation & AWS CDK
focus: infrastructure as code for data pipelines, templates and stacks, change sets, drift detection, CDK constructs in code synthesising CloudFormation, SAM for serverless, CI/CD with CodePipeline
